annual.note: Fiscal year ended May 2, 2026 (52 weeks), audited 10-K filed 2026-06-15. No debt of any kind. Cash+ST investments = 1,443.286. Technology-license obligations are financed through financing cash flow (payments $6.6M in FY26; undiscounted remaining $22.2M at May 2, 2026 per Note 9: FY27 12.555, FY28 6.803, FY29 2.850) but their balance-sheet carrying amount is not separately disclosed (inside other current/non-current liabilities), so they are NOT included in debt; the reviewed research package treats the Q1 FY27 amount (9.495) as debt-like. Unvested awards: 7.2M RSUs + 1.5M PSUs (PSU count is at target except the 0.2M FY25 PSUs earned at 200% per Note 11; PSUs can earn 0-200%+). Post-period events in the 10-K (Note 16, subsequent events, not on this balance sheet): DustPhotonics acquired May 2026 for $770M cash + ~0.8M shares plus contingent consideration up to ~2.8M shares and $31.6M cash; CEO special PSUs (1.437M = 6 x 239,500) approved May 28, 2026. Hyperlume acquisition (Sept 2025, $92.0M cash) and Comira (Feb 2026, $35.1M cash) are in the balance sheet. ATM offering of $750M completed in FY26 (4.82M shares, $736.3M net) is in the share count.

ttm.note: Latest filed quarterly report on/before 2026-10-21: 10-Q for quarter ended Aug 1, 2026 (filed 2026-09-02). The only 8-K after is Oct 16 (annual meeting votes). No debt. DustPhotonics acquired May 28, 2026: cash $769.6M, 0.76M shares issued ($169.1M), replacement awards $2.5M, contingent consideration $310.0M (equity $300.0M + liability $10.0M), total purchase consideration $1,251.1M; goodwill rose to $986.4M, DTL $53.7M. Cash fell to $466.9M (acquisition). Other items to know: (1) 0.132M unvested restricted shares of a newly formed Hyperlume-related subsidiary exchangeable into Credo shares are probably outside the 187.768M count (10-Q Note 10; $146.01/share grant-date fair value); 0.132M restricted shares issued directly to the other founder are likely already in outstanding shares. (2) Technology-license obligations: undiscounted $9.495M remaining at Aug 1, 2026 (Note 9), financing-classified but carrying amount not disclosed, NOT in debt. (3) Refundable supplier capacity deposits $88.4M asset; an additional $102.4M deposit agreed after Aug 1. (4) Warrants: none outstanding; Amazon warrant fully exercised in FY26. (5) 10-Q does not give a max share count for the DustPhotonics earn-out; 10-K Note 16 says up to ~2.8M shares + $31.6M cash.
